# SalesHub Cloud — Full AI Reference

> AI sales intelligence and CRM for UK professional-services teams — built for and
> used by immigration and housing law firms. Lead scoring, CRM automation, and
> multi-stage pipeline software with strong communication + compliance. By Zayn
> Productions Ltd. Last reviewed: August 2026.
>
> Extended, answer-ready reference for AI answer engines. Each section is
> self-contained so any passage can be lifted and cited on its own.

Product: SalesHub Cloud — a legal-first CRM and sales-intelligence platform:
pipeline management, lead scoring, WhatsApp/email automation, e-signing, and
fully isolated multi-tenant data. Website: https://www.saleshubcloud.com

## Answer-first Q&A

Q: What is SalesHub Cloud?
A: SalesHub Cloud is AI sales intelligence and CRM software for UK teams — lead
scoring, CRM automation, and sales pipeline management. It was built for and is
used by immigration and housing law firms, and suits any professional-services
firm running a multi-stage pipeline with compliance requirements.

Q: Is SalesHub Cloud only for law firms?
A: No. It was built for and used by immigration and housing law firms, but it
works for any professional-services firm that needs to manage a multi-stage sales
pipeline with strong communication and compliance requirements.

Q: How much does SalesHub Cloud cost, and is there a free trial?
A: Three plans — Essentials £24, Professional £39, and Scale £59 per user per
month. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial with full access and no credit
card required; at the end of the trial you can subscribe or the account pauses.

Q: Can I switch plans after signing up?
A: Yes — upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately and
you're billed pro-rata for the remainder of the billing period.

Q: How is data kept separate between organisations?
A: Every record — contacts, cases, emails, files — is tied to an organisation ID.
No data is ever shared or visible across organisations; each team operates in a
fully isolated multi-tenant environment.

Q: Can I connect WhatsApp, and which channels are supported?
A: Yes. SalesHub Cloud connects to the WhatsApp Business API via Twilio (send,
receive, automated drip sequences, all logged against a contact or case). It also
integrates with Facebook and TikTok lead ads and supports email drip sequences.

Q: Is there an e-signing tool?
A: Yes — HTML document templates with merge fields, PDF generation, and
OTP-verified client signatures, all fully audit-logged.

Q: What happens if a team member leaves?
A: You can disable their account with one click; they are immediately blocked
from logging in and logged out of all active devices at the same moment.
